title: VDBE immediate and deferred foreign-key commit guards

scope.rationale: These guards convert outstanding immediate or connection-deferred foreign-key counts into the exact VDBE constraint state, abort policy, fixed error message, and prepare-mode-dependent return code used by halt/commit.

external_source_responsibilities: Connection-owned fixed-message duplication is the no-format-specifier specialization of sqlite3VdbeError
dependencies.caller_closure: The private error transition and both active immediate/deferred guards are assigned. Constraint producers and halt callers remain integration work.

inputs: Vdbe nFkConstraint, connection nDeferredCons/nDeferredImmCons, and prepare flags
outputs: SQLITE_OK with no mutation when selected counts are zero; otherwise error/extended constraint return and Vdbe error state
contracts.ownership: On violation, any prior Vdbe.zErrMsg is consumed and replaced by a connection-owned fixed message, or null on OOM.
contracts.state_and_results: Violation always sets rc=SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_FOREIGNKEY and errorAction=OE_Abort. Return is SQLITE_ERROR unless SQLITE_PREPARE_SAVESQL is set, then the extended constraint code.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No callback or I/O; caller holds connection mutex.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Message allocation OOM sets sticky connection OOM but preserves the source rc/action and prepare-dependent return. Zero-count guards preserve all prior Vdbe error state.

representation_differences: The fixed no-format-argument sqlite3VdbeError call is specialized to exact connection string duplication; resulting bytes, ownership, replacement, and OOM behavior are unchanged.

oracle.protocol: The shared worker seeds prior rc/action/message state, exercises zero/nonzero immediate and deferred counts with and without SQLITE_PREPARE_SAVESQL, then disables lookaside and forces fixed-message allocation OOM. C and Zig compare 366 observations.
internal_observations: sum of deferred and deferred-immediate counts
oracle.normalization: Return codes, rc, action, prepare flags, message bytes/nullness, and OOM state are exact.

assurance.oom: Deterministic no-lookaside message-allocation failure preserves rc/action/return while publishing null and sticky OOM.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O/callback; caller mutex remains integration obligation.
assurance.malformed_input: Counters are source i64 values; zero and positive representative states are covered. Negative counters are forbidden by their external owners.
assurance.continuation: No-violation paths preserve seeded state; all violation paths remain safe for subsequent halt/error transfer.
assurance.performance: Constant-time count checks and one allocation only on violation preserve source shape.

integration.native_call_path: Symbolic worker reaches exact Vdbe/Sqlite3 counters and connection allocator. VDBE halt and FK producer call paths remain handwritten.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Integrate constraint producers and sqlite3VdbeHalt.

independent_review.notes: Requires halt-path integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

callees: vdbeFkError sets extended FK constraint rc and OE_Abort before replacing zErrMsg through sqlite3VdbeError

Immediate guard selects Vdbe.nFkConstraint; deferred guard selects connection nDeferredCons+nDeferredImmCons and leaves state untouched at zero
assertions_branches_cleanup: All nine behavior IDs cover message return policy and both zero/nonzero count guards
